description: Corrections applied on top of the converted data and the 2024-2025 refresh by scripts/apply_data_corrections.py. See docs/data_audit_findings.md for the evidence behind each value.

S&P 500._source: Official S&P 500 total return (S&P Dow Jones Indices, via slickcharts.com/sp500/returns); the original upmyinterest value 30.92 is wrong

MSCI World ex USA index._source: MSCI World ex USA index factsheet, gross returns in USD (same index as the 1970-2023 history; the refresh used VEA, a different index)

Precious Metals._source: GDX, Portfolio Visualizer's proxy fund since 2018 (totalrealreturns.com/n/GDX)

REIT._source: Dow Jones Select RESI via upmyinterest.com/us-real-estate (same as history)

Gold._source: Gold price via upmyinterest.com/gold (same as history)

NASDAQ100._source: NASDAQ-100 total return via upmyinterest.com/nasdaq100 (same as history)

Short Term Treasury._source: VFISX, Portfolio Visualizer's proxy fund (bond-fund values uncertain by about 0.4 pp)

Intermediate Term Treasury._source: VFITX, Portfolio Visualizer's proxy fund (bond-fund values uncertain by about 0.4 pp)

Long Term Treasury._source: VUSTX, Portfolio Visualizer's proxy fund (bond-fund values uncertain by about 0.4 pp)

10-Year US Treasury._source: This series is the average 10-year yield (FRED GS10 annual mean), not a return; 2024-2025 now follow the same definition

inflation._source: US CPI-U not seasonally adjusted (FRED CPIAUCNS), December to December, as in the Shiller-based history

global_ex_us_formula._note: Pending decision: the original data defines Global ex US Stock Market as 0.6 * S&P 500 + 0.4 * MSCI World ex USA. Kept until decided; recomputed so it reflects corrected inputs.

sp500_monthly._source: From 2011-02 the legacy monthly series follows the Irish CSPX ETF (15% dividend withholding, 0.07% fee). 2024-2025 official total returns are adjusted the same way: r - 0.15 * dividend_yield / 12 - 0.07 / 12. Dividend yields: multpl.com S&P 500 dividend yield by month (prior month end).

us_cpi_monthly._source: FRED CPIAUCNS (CPI-U, not seasonally adjusted), matching the legacy Shiller column. October 2025 was not published (federal shutdown); geometric mean of September and November.
